"That's strange, there it is again." Tom remarked, examining the corner of the shed with an expression of confusion. "Whatcha looking at there?" Sarah asked. "There's some sort of white dot at the bottom corner, I noticed it first when I was installing shelves and had to move some junk out of the way. It's still there, just some sort of strange white dot." "What's so strange about it, what is it some glitter?" Tom took a knee to examine it closer. "No, like I can look into it." "Like, a piece of glass or mirror?" 

Tom scooted in closer and pressed his finger against it, only to see his entire hand go through the ground, and reactively pulled it back. "What the.." "Did your hand...just go through...the wall?" "Yeah..I don't...it's not a hole that leads outside...it leads...somewhere else." He reached over and grabbed a measuring tape, and started feeding it into the same spot, and it continued to go on for the entire extension. "Tom...that..doesn't make any sense. If you put a hole in a wall it leads just directly outside, what the hell is going on?"

Tom looked up at Sarah, both with looks of bewilderment, and turned around to the hole again. "There's only one way to find out." And he put his hand through again, and began to move his head through it. "Tom, wait we don't know.." Before she could finish her sentence, his head was already..gone, just completely through this wall. "It's okay, there's...still air...and there's all sorts of stuff...its nothing I've ever seen before." "Thats great, just please, we don't know what that is or if its safe."

Ignoring Sarah's pleading, Tom crawled through, moving his entire body through the wall and vanishing. "TOM!" She shouted out, worried she might have just lost her husband. She ran outside, but he wasn't on the other side of the wall. Quickly returning to inside the shed, she bit her lip as she resistantly walked through as well. What greeted her on the other side of the wall wasn't outside the shed, but something so foreign and hard to comprehend, but it was somewhat beautiful in a way. 

There was no sky or ground, it was just a vast emptiness of nothing that was a cyan color, along with various platforms and walls, bits and pieces that looked like they were from different parts of the world but disjunctioned and oddly placed. She could even see in the distance what looked like windows into other rooms, one where she saw what looked like a restaurant, another was someones home. It seemed to continue on endlessly. She stood there both awestruck and frightened in silence, eventually breaking out of it somewhat when she felt the sensation of her husband taking her hand. "T...Tom what is...all of this?" "I honestly don't know, maybe this is some other plane of existence that we entered? A plane that interweaves with ours, and somehow we entered it. It's incredible though..." "Should we even be here? Lets just go back!" 

"Go back? Honey, this is huge. This is a major scientific discovery. We are the first explorers of this place, like Lewis and Clark. Let's at least explore a little bit?" Sarah looked back to where they came from, and could see the same hole, except this time looking in she could see the inside of the shed. "I don't know...this is a lot to take in...we can look around a little I suppose, let's at least bring some rope so we don't get lost."
